In GitHub: **Pull requests → New pull request → base: existing main → compare: lab/network → Files changed → Create pull request**. Inspect required checks, resolve conversations, then **Merge pull request → Confirm merge**. The author may merge their own passing PR; no independent PR/deployment reviewer or fabricated self-approval.

### 3. Inspect the actual network

Open [Azure portal](https://portal.azure.com) → **Directories + subscriptions → assigned directory/subscription → Resource groups → assigned RG → owner-provided VNet name**. Compare with owner inputs; retain resource IDs privately.

| Click | Expected configuration |
| --- | --- |
| VNet **Overview → JSON View** | Approved region; `provisioningState: Succeeded` |
| VNet **Address space** | Approved CIDR ranges |
| VNet **Subnets → each subnet** | Approved names/prefixes; NSG association `<name>-nsg` |
| VNet **JSON View → properties.subnets** | Every `defaultOutboundAccess: false` |
| RG → **&lt;name&gt;-nsg → Subnets** | Same subnet associations |
| VNet and NSG **Tags** | `workshop=ws2`, `environment=dev` |

Subnets are nested, not standalone RG rows. Green Actions/mocks are not configuration proof; no VM/public IP/connectivity result is claimed.

Obtain owner approval; set literal `activity = "actions-azure-updated"` in the same `locals.tags`. Keep names/CIDRs/subnet keys/required tags. Repeat checks and passing PR merge above. Require an in-place update, no replacement, same VNet/subnet/NSG IDs; refresh portal **Tags** for the new value.

**Actions → Trusted AVM delivery → Run workflow → main → operation: followup** only. Require a **fresh plan exit 0** and **Confirm AVM no-change**; exit 2 is not success. Followup never applies; scheduled drift is report-only.

### 5. Separately authorize cleanup

The **current authenticated repository admin**, with separate explicit owner authorization for the whole owned workload, selects **Actions → Trusted AVM cleanup (explicit owner authorization required) → Run workflow → main**.

Required string `authorization`: `destroy:1379147533:<current full main SHA>:<WS2_STATE_LOCK_ID>`. Owner supplies the real 40-character SHA/state-lock value; never submit placeholders. No operation input or independent cleanup reviewer.

Require **Apply exact authorized AVM destroy plan**, same-run exact saved destroy plan, empty managed state and portal VNet/NSG absence. Retain RG/backend/identities/runner. Ordinary pushes never clean up; regular deletion/replacement is rejected.

**Expected:** only actual checks establish live outcomes; otherwise **live continuation pending**. Source maintenance stays on dev.

**Recovery:** stop and contact the owner; never force-unlock, widen roles, delete state or use local destroy.
